SECTION_A1_DEFECT_ADJUDICATION.DEFECT_SUMMARY: The frozen parent asserts, in four places, that the Supabase CLI 2.109.1 `backups` subcommand exposes ONLY `list`. That assertion is false. Re-running `./node_modules/.bin/supabase backups --help` at the SAME pinned version measured by the parent (2.109.1, no `--experimental` flag) shows SUBCOMMANDS = `list` ("Lists available physical backups") AND `restore` ("Restore to a specific timestamp using PITR"). `supabase backups restore --help` shows exactly two flags: `--project-ref` and `--timestamp`/`-t` (epoch seconds); there is no destination or target-override flag of any kind.
SECTION_A1_DEFECT_ADJUDICATION.WHY_THE_CONCLUSION_IS_NOT_WEAKENED: The parent's operative prohibition was never conditioned on the tool lacking a restore command. EXPLICIT_NON_AUTHORIZATIONS already bars 'Triggering a restore, of any artifact, by any mechanism, anywhere', and CAPABILITY.MANAGEMENT_PLANE.must_not already bars using the management-plane token to 'restore a backup'. Both rest on AUTHORITY, not on alleged tool incapability, and neither is touched by this amendment. What changes is only the FACTUAL PREMISE offered in support of adjudication E's third ground and gap MG-4 -- and the corrected premise is STRONGER than the false one: `backups restore` is confirmed, by directly reading its flag surface, to take only a project ref and a timestamp with NO separate-target parameter, so the restore act it exposes is CONFIRMED IN-PLACE rather than merely presumed in-place by the absence of any restore command at all.

SECTION_A7_F_IC_3_RESTORE_PROOF_CLARIFIC.tension_as_measured: The companion manifest's NC-10 states 'BACKUP_PACKET and RESTORE_PROOF are reused with no field added, removed or reordered'. The authority separately requires RESTORE_PROOF evidence to carry container identity, engine versions, an explicit storage-byte out-of-scope declaration (PRI-7), and an explicit statement of whether a governed erasure exists that a restore would resurrect. Read without cross-reference, these can appear to be NEW fields NC-10 forbids.
SECTION_A7_F_IC_3_RESTORE_PROOF_CLARIFIC.resolution: Not a contradiction. The frozen parent RESTORE_PROOF packet, defined at docs/ops/release/STAGING_RELEASE_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json EVIDENCE_PACKETS.packets[RESTORE_PROOF].contents, has exactly FIVE frozen fields: (1) the backup identifier restored from, (2) the target restored into, (3) timestamps for start and completion, (4) post-restore verification results, (5) the roll-forward performed afterwards and to which point. Every item the authority additionally requires is a CONSTRAINED INSTANTIATION of one of these five, never a sixth field.

explicit_mapping.required_content: container identity (image, digest, engine version, creation/destruction timestamps)
explicit_mapping.instantiates: field (2) 'the target restored into' -- a disposable container IS the target restored into, and its identity is what makes that field meaningful when the target is not a hosted project.

explicit_mapping.required_content: engine version skew recorded (rehearsal image 17.6.1.143 vs measured live target 17.6.1.155)
explicit_mapping.instantiates: field (2), as part of the same target-identity content: a verifier cannot judge 'what was restored into' without knowing which engine build it was.

field (4) 'post-restore verification results' -- PRI-7 IS a post-restore verification check, and its explicit-declaration requirement is part of stating that check's result honestly rather than by omission.

explicit_mapping.required_content: the explicit statement of whether a governed erasure exists that a restore would resurrect
explicit_mapping.instantiates: field (4) 'post-restore verification results' -- it is a verification result about the restored data's relationship to prior lawful erasures, required so the evidence does not silently omit a check the authority elsewhere flags as relevant to ENV-07 but does not itself perform.

SECTION_A7_F_IC_3_RESTORE_PROOF_CLARIFIC.no_field_added: CONFIRMED. Every additional item the authority requires is content WITHIN one of the five frozen fields. The amendment adds no sixth field, and NC-10 in the companion manifest remains CORRECT as originally written -- it required no supersession, only this explicit cross-reference, which SECTION_A8 of the companion manifest amendment turns into an auditable control.
SECTION_A7_F_IC_3_RESTORE_PROOF_CLARIFIC.does_not_enlarge_ENV_07: CONFIRMED. This clarification is entirely internal to the frozen five-field RESTORE_PROOF shape and to invariants the authority already declared (PRI-7, the tombstone-scope note). It adds no new surface requirement, does not require Auth or Storage evidence for D1/S8, and does not advance ENV-07's own binding deadline. ENV-07.canonical_binding NO_GATE_MUTATION, cited in the parent authority's CONTROLLING_AUTHORITY, is untouched.
